sloka: सम्पतन्त्यथ भूतानि दृश्यन्ते च यथाक्रमम् ।गृध्रचक्रं महच्चात्र ज्वलनोद्गारिभिर्मुखैः ।। ७.६.५६ ॥
transliteration: sampatantyatha bhūtāni dṛśyante ca yathākramam ।gṛdhracakraṁ mahaccātra jvalanodgāribhirmukhaiḥ ।। 7.6.56 ॥

translations.english: Then, ominous spirits were seen appearing successively, and a large flock of vultures with flame-emitting mouths was also present.
